capabilities: Count newly typed characters, Chinese characters, or English words per session
Measure writing time, idle time, and total time with a configurable idle threshold
Calculate average speed from a 60-second sliding window
Display focus rate as a progress bar in a sidebar
Pause, resume, and start new tracking sessions
extras: Works on desktop and mobile using only browser timers and editor events; all statistics are computed locally with no external services.
problem: Obsidian's word count shows a static total for a note but does not track what you typed in the current session, how long you wrote, or how focused you were.
summary: Writing session tracker that counts newly typed characters or words and shows writing time, idle time, average speed, and focus rate in a sidebar.
